column1: # Corrections to what the extractor reads, for the A2 scan where OCR loses a lesson.
# The A2 new-word list is printed in coloured bold on a coloured band, which tesseract
# reads unreliably and sometimes drops entirely; four lessons came back with no words
# at all. Those lists were transcribed from the rendered pages by hand. Titles are
# corrected where OCR mangled a letter or picked up a stray mark.
# Columns: book <TAB> lesson number <TAB> field (title|words) <TAB> value
# "words" is comma separated, exactly as the book prints it.
